## Step 3: Resolution  
### Failed Transactions  
**Resolution Options:**  
**Option A: Reprocess**
- Confirm funds now available
- Resubmit transaction
- Confirm success to customer
- Close exception  
**Option B: Refund + Compensation**
- If funds were debited despite failure: Refund immediately
- Add interest (if applicable)
- Apologize for inconvenience
- Consider compensation (if service failure)  
**Option C: Manual Facilitation**
- Customer wants to proceed but system blocks
- Staff can manually facilitate (with approvals)
- Document reason for manual override

raw_entities.name: Failed Transaction Resolution Process
raw_entities.description: End-to-end procedure for resolving failed transactions on customer accounts. Defines three resolution pathways: reprocessing with fund confirmation, refund with compensation, or manual facilitation with documented override approval. Scope covers transaction failures where funds were debited or processing was blocked by system controls.

raw_entities.name: Fund Availability Confirmation
raw_entities.description: Verification step to confirm that customer funds are now available before reprocessing a failed transaction. Precedes resubmission under Option A.

raw_entities.name: Transaction Resubmission
raw_entities.description: Operational step to resubmit a previously failed transaction to the payment system after fund availability has been confirmed. Part of Option A resolution pathway.

raw_entities.name: Transaction Success Confirmation to Customer
raw_entities.description: Customer-facing notification step confirming successful reprocessing of a previously failed transaction. Completes Option A pathway.

raw_entities.name: Exception Closure
raw_entities.description: Administrative step to formally close the exception record after successful transaction resolution. Marks the end of the resolution workflow.

raw_entities.name: Refund Processing
raw_entities.description: Immediate refund of funds to customer account when funds were debited despite transaction failure. First step in Option B compensation pathway.
context: If funds were debited despite failure: Refund immediately

raw_entities.name: Interest Addition
raw_entities.description: Conditional step to add interest to refunded amount where applicable, compensating customer for loss of use of funds during failed transaction period.

raw_entities.name: Service Failure Apology
raw_entities.description: Customer communication step acknowledging service failure and expressing apology. Part of Option B resolution pathway.

raw_entities.name: Compensation Assessment
raw_entities.description: Discretionary assessment step to determine whether additional compensation beyond refund and interest is warranted based on service failure severity.

raw_entities.name: Manual Transaction Facilitation
raw_entities.description: Staff-executed step to manually process a transaction when customer wishes to proceed but system controls block the transaction. Requires documented approvals and override justification.

raw_entities.name: Manual Override Documentation
raw_entities.description: Mandatory documentation step recording the business reason and approval authority for any manual transaction facilitation override.

raw_entities.name: Operations Staff - Transaction Resolution
raw_entities.description: Operations staff responsible for executing transaction resolution steps including fund confirmation, refund processing, customer communication, and manual transaction facilitation with appropriate approvals.

raw_entities.name: Approval Authority - Manual Override
raw_entities.description: Unspecified approval authority required to authorize manual transaction facilitation when system controls would otherwise block processing.

raw_entities.name: Transaction Reprocessing Feasibility Gate
raw_entities.description: Decision gate determining whether funds are now available to support reprocessing of a failed transaction. Pass leads to resubmission; fail triggers alternative resolution pathways.

raw_entities.name: Funds Debited Despite Failure Check
raw_entities.description: Decision gate determining whether funds were actually debited from customer account despite transaction failure. Pass triggers immediate refund pathway; fail indicates no refund required.
context: If funds were debited despite failure: Refund immediately

raw_entities.name: Service Failure Compensation Eligibility Gate
raw_entities.description: Discretionary decision gate assessing whether service failure warrants compensation beyond refund and interest. Outcome determines compensation amount or denial.

raw_entities.name: Manual Facilitation Authorization Gate
raw_entities.description: Approval gate determining whether manual transaction facilitation is authorized when customer requests processing despite system block. Requires documented business justification.

raw_entities.name: Failed Transaction
raw_entities.description: A financial transaction that failed to process successfully, potentially resulting in funds being debited despite failure or system blocking. Subject of the resolution process defined in this document.

raw_entities.name: Customer
raw_entities.description: Individual customer whose transaction has failed and who is subject to resolution actions including refund, compensation, and manual facilitation requests.
context: Customer wants to proceed but system blocks
